positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
I transformed static Excel financial models into scalable, interactive web applications using JavaScript, React, Node.js, and CSS, integrating advanced predictive analytics and valuation algorithms to deliver real-time financial insights for Fintech startup. By modernizing legacy systems, I enabled dynamic data visualization and user-friendly interfaces for complex financial analysis.  

I engineered and deployed cloud-native solutions on AWS and Azure, leveraging PostgreSQL for high-performance financial data processing. These architectures ensured scalability, high availability, and secure data handling, supporting real-time projections and large-scale financial modeling.  

To streamline operations, I developed automated data pipelines and CI/CD workflows, reducing manual errors and accelerating analytics delivery. This automation enhanced system reliability while enabling stakeholders to access up-to-date financial metrics and forecasts instantly.  

Additionally, I applied statistical modeling, machine learning, and quantitative techniques to optimize investment strategies, equity valuations, and risk assessments. My work supported data-driven decision-making in financial planning, portfolio management, and strategic investments.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Spearheaded front-end and back-end development initiatives, optimizing the Trips section to drive a 12% boost in user engagement metrics, enhancing overall platform usability and customer satisfaction.

Delivered 10+ innovative front-end features leveraging TypeScript, CSS, and HTML, alongside robust back-end solutions in Kotlin, significantly expanding website functionality and user interactivity.

Engineered 4+ comprehensive automated test suites using Cypress, achieving an industry-leading 95% bug detection rate and ensuring flawless component integration and system reliability.

Identified and resolved critical performance bottlenecks, reducing page load times by 20% and elevating website speed and responsiveness, directly improving user retention and satisfaction.

Collaborated seamlessly with cross-functional teams, including junior and senior engineers, UX designers, and product managers, to deliver high-quality, user-centric solutions on time and within scope.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), React.js and +8 skills
